Debt of Honor When you come to the aid of a neighboring ruler in desperate situations, or render them a special favor, honor obliges them to repay you with a diplomatic concession. This may be a peace treaty, joining your state, leaving another state, or a substantial tribute. Choose the diplomatic action you need in the Politics menu of their province and claim your reward! Hint: $ You don't have to use the Debt of Honor right away - it will remain valid as long as either your ruler or the indebted ruler is alive.
